_schema.frame: origin = body centre (fly with it on the gameplay plane), glTF +X = nose, +Y = up
_schema.length: overall length in grid units (ship cell = 1)
_schema.landingHeight: distance from the origin down to the skids / belly: on a pad put the origin this high above the pad EMPTY (base drone_pad, home drone_pad_<i>, scout_bay)

nodes.Cargo_Pod: detachable container (pivot = pod centre); hide when empty
nodes.beacon_0/1: port red / starboard green nav lamps
nodes.thruster_0/1: EMPTY nozzle exits, local +X = exhaust direction

drone_mining.label: Mining drone
drone_mining.spec: mines asteroids within 60 u of the ship, 0.8 u/s

nodes.Drone_Laser: emitter on the top front between the prongs, aim around local +Y (+-70 deg)
nodes.Muzzle: EMPTY beam origin (child of Drone_Laser), +X = beam

drone_repair.label: Repair drone
drone_repair.spec: repairs parts 2 HP/s out of combat

nodes.Repair_Arm_L/R: welding arms, swing around local +Y (pivot = shoulder)
nodes.Repair_Tip_L/R: EMPTY spark / repair beam origins (children of the arms)

drone_scout.label: Scout drone
drone_scout.spec: flies to a signal and back, 10-30 game min, visible on the map
